name: hono-api
title: Hono API
blurb: Hono JSON API on Node: typed routes, in-memory app.request() tests, tsc build, no bundler

verify.name: http
verify.cmd: if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5321/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'port 5321 is already answering - stop that process before running this step'; exit 1; fi; PORT=5321 node dist/server.js >.hono.log 2>&1 & srv=$!; ok=1; for _ in $(seq 1 120); do if curl --max-time 2 -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5321/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=0; break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; kill -0 $srv 2>/dev/null || { echo 'the server exited before it answered'; exit 1; }; if [ $ok -ne 0 ]; then cat .hono.log; kill $srv 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; body=$(curl --max-time 10 -fsS 'http://127.0.0.1:5321/stats?text=hello%20world%0A'); post=$(curl --max-time 10 -fsS -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary '{"text":"a b\nc\n"}' http://127.0.0.1:5321/stats); bad=$(curl --max-time 10 -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}' http://127.0.0.1:5321/stats); missing=$(curl --max-time 10 -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5321/nope); kill $srv 2>/dev/null; wait $srv 2>/dev/null; printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q '"lines":1' && printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q '"bytes":12' && printf '%s' "$post" | grep -q '"lines":2' && printf '%s' "$post" | grep -q '"words":3' && test "$bad" = 422 && test "$missing" = 404
